reviews.review: Most realistic Military sim i have come across. Must have good team skills to win

immerse yourself as a corrupt and selfish egotistical maniac by commanding neurally impaired AI combatants to unleash hell on your command to execute your teammates ISIS style for the sake of your entertainment


any civilian bystanders witnessing these actions will be gifted several acts of warcrimes upon them for not looking the other way

10/10

Honestly I really loved this game and played it a lot when I bought it but it is a little glitchy and the movement is also quite squishy but still the game is what a full realistic game is like and it really has a lot of content including the long Campaign and the Multiplayer and all the other battle modes. All together I rate this game a 8/10

2035 setting I really dislike. Armor hit boxes are strange. (YES I tested in in virtual arsenal map) 7.62 to the arm should take that arm at least out of the fight and more things like this.

Also you need dlc for real weapons. I don't care if the mx series was a real prototype. No one is using it, do not tell me that it was a good idea for them to use it in this. Every tactical shooter, milsim,  has been ruined by people who think they know what real is but live in a fantasy world. Stamina and weapon handling is extremely unrealistic. It's like being overweight and out of shape. 

I have used 5 different graphics cards. 970, 1080, 1080ti, 3080, radeon pro w6800. Perfomance always sucked. Current cpu is a 5950x
Wish they would fix this. This is really the biggest gripe.

friendly fire from ai is unacceptable. fanbois defend it though. The amount of times i have had ai team mates walk up behind me and shoot me in the back because they wanted to move to different cover is ridiculous. I usually don't play with ai because of this.  and no I did not shoot a friendly. I resent the player base honestly of most games now days. People who defend this are why games are bad now days.

Fanbois always list a bunch of workarounds and say it is your fault the ai you had to separate yourself from(because they are death traps) moved to a new location behind and you and murders you. I so rarely ever kill my own team either. Same with other players. They are all fine in this game. The ai is unacceptable. If you criticize a mechanic you want fixed you get told you are playing wrong.  If there was a game simulating trains and they were on roads because the devs were not willing to fix it. They would defend it.  My own team mate ai kills me 70% of the time if I am playing with AI. EDIT: noticed this only in warlords  I guess. Make of that what you will.

Can't reload emplaced weapons until the belt is empty, you can die from climbing on a rock. I have seen enemies walk through doors and walls more times than I can count, and the list goes on and on. 

A lot of this would bother me less if performance was better.

Arma 2  I get like 165fps.... It looks the same too..
